content.text: All tests pass. Let me update the README to accurately describe the delivered architecture, then do a full final validation:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/project/README.md <<'EOF'
# Eywa offline campaign toolkit

The editable package is under src/eywa. campaign_cli.py supplies JSON framing
and adds the local src directory, so no installation is necessary. Run it with
Python 3.11.14. All runtime dependencies are in the standard library.

ast.py defines named model types, the type table with transparent alias
resolution, and typed predicate expressions with exact evaluation (modulo
arithmetic, short-circuit connectives, lexical `all` bindings).
oracles.py contains the symbolic type/aggregate visitors: the MainBuilder
convention numbering walker, the declaration postorder collector, and the
inverse reader that recovers typed values from leaf objects.
composer.py owns module dependencies (call/pipe prerequisites), root-scoped
compilation order, and composed filter application expansion.
regex.py owns regular-language pattern parsing and whole-string matching.
run.py computes typed corpus identity fingerprints.
state.py prepares stateful replay preambles with exact (cost, commands,
lexicographic) minimization.
wire.py strictly decodes canonical base64 KTEST v3 transports.
offline.py composes the pipeline: plan compilation, per-run decoding and
recovery, bad_input attestation, filtering, reachability, and corpus assembly.

The authoritative behavior and output contract are in /workspace/PROTOCOL.md.
All project files may be edited or reorganized. The output certificate is the
interface; private verifier code is never an import dependency.
EOF
